name: Hundred Years War
note: Open war after the homage crisis and Crécy. Calais has just fallen.

name: Second War of Independence
note: David II is a prisoner in England after Neville's Cross.

name: Strait campaigns
note: Castile presses Granada after the Salado victory; intermittent sieges.

name: Gulf rivalry
note: Commercial and naval rivalry in the eastern Mediterranean.

name: Angevin revenge
note: Louis I prepares war over the murder of his brother Andrew.

name: Serbian expansion
note: Dusan's imperial coronation follows conquests in Macedonia.

name: Imperial election
note: Charles IV is anti-king against Louis IV. Not modeled as a vassal bond.

name: Aquitaine homage
note: Edward holds Aquitaine and Calais. He is not stored as Philippe's vassal because a character may have only one current liege.
